name: shorted-admin
description: Monitor Shorted asynchronous jobs, execution history, enrichment queues and source health through the administrator MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Inspect Shorted Cloud Run jobs and execution history, scheduler triggers, enrichment queue states, and housing rig reports in an interactive admin view. Administrator OAuth is required. Publishing and job execution tools are available only with their separate scopes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open Shorted Admin and show running jobs, failures and source health.
